data.name: Mk
data.gender_notes: Mk is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mk is a Sanskrit name derived from the god Agni, the god of fire in Hindu mythology. Agni is considered the god of the hearth and the sacred fire, representing the purifying and transformative power of fire. The name Mk is believed to bestow upon the bearer the strength, courage, and wisdom of this powerful deity. The name Mk carries the meaning “God of Fire” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mk usually hope their child will grow to embody god of fire and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the transformative power of fire in your journey through life.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mk total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
